# Light Language – lightlanguage.justbe.works

> Educational site: Light Language as **vibrational, often channeled** communication (sound, speech, writing, movement)—insight from **higher consciousness** or the **soul**, for **healing**, **clearing energy**, and **spiritual opening**, **felt in the heart** more than parsed by the logical mind; plus why it is **not a school-taught language**, themes from the Beginning LL Student Manual (2014), and **Light Language Grid Creator** (88 shapes, 144 colours, grids, picture export) for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/light-language-grid-creator/id6758855353)).

Some visitors also explore **Reiki** and energy work; this site’s focus remains **light language**, study PDFs, and **Light Language Grid Creator** (not Reiki instruction).
